newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-JOHN BARNARD ARRIVAL GIVES NEW HOPE TO ARROWS.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-JOHN BARNARD ARRIVAL GIVES NEW HOPE TO ARROWS.

text.p: The Arrows Formula One team appointed top British designer John Barnard on Tuesday in a move that might encourage world champion Damon Hill to stay for another season.

Hill has failed to finish any of the opening five races this season and, after crashing out of the San Marino Grand Prix two weeks ago, he made it clear that he would consider his future at the team if no improvements had been made by the middle of the year.

"It is beginning to get into the phase when, if we don't make some progress or if things aren't done, we are going to be floundering," Hill said. "We are going to be slipping further and further down the field.

"I became a victim of not planning ahead enough last season so I am making sure that doesn't happen this time." Hill won the title with Williams but was dropped from the team at the end of the season.

Although Barnard is likely to concentrate his work on next year's car, it is probable that he will make improvements to the current Arrows-Yamaha A18, which was designed by Frank Dernie, who has now left the team.
Barnard has established himself as one of the sport's top designers after successful spells with the McLaren, Benetton and Ferrari teams.
Most recently he worked for Ferrari, spending five seasons spearheading the Italian team's assault on the world championship from his base in Surrey.
Barnard left Ferrari earlier this year when the Italian team decided to concentrate its design activities in Italy.
